“黄鼠狼？”王林一怔，他第一个想到的就是之前嘲笑自己的那个黄衣青年，觉得他比较符合这个称呼，可心里不知到底对方说的是不是他。
“啊？你没看到他？就是负责安排记名弟子工作的那个男的，他是也是记名弟子，不过已经获得了修炼仙法的资格，身穿黄衣，长的一看就不是啥好人，跟个狼崽子似的，我们私底下都这么叫他。”张虎喝了口水，咬牙切齿的解释道。
王林吃了口甘薯，说道：“我知道你说的是谁了，今天看到他了，和我说从明天开始每天挑满十缸水，否则没有饭吃。”
张虎目瞪口呆，盯着王林看了许久，忽然问道：“哥们，你是不是以前和他有仇？”
王林摇头，问道：“怎么了？”
张虎以一副可怜的目光看了眼王林，问道：“王林，你是不是以为装水的大缸，就和咱家里用的那样，这么大？”说着，他还用手比划了一下。
王林心中升起不好的预感，点了点头。
张虎苦笑，说道：“你一定是得罪黄鼠狼了，他说的大缸，是和我们这个屋子差不多大，整整十缸水……王林，这些甘薯我不要了，你留着吧，我约莫你能四五天吃一顿饭就不错了。你是新来的，山里几个产野果的地方都被别人霸占了，只有老人才能去摘几个，我还是明天吃我的野果吧。”说完，他把剩下的几块甘薯放在桌子上，叹了口气，重新躺在床铺睡下。
王林心底冒起一丝邪火，他咬了咬牙，想到父母满怀期望的目光，强行把火气压下，憋着一肚子气躺在床上睡着了。
第二日天未亮，他就从床上爬起，张虎还在打着呼噜，王林换上灰衣，连忙向杂物处走去，来到此地的一刻，太阳渐渐从东方出现，黄衣青年推开房门，斜着眼睛看了眼王林，阴阳怪调道：“还算守时，进去拿水桶吧，顺着东门出去，山间有个泉眼，到那里挑水。”
说完，他不在理会王林，盘膝坐在地上，对着日出缓缓的吐纳，一丝丝淡淡的白气从他鼻间散出，如两条白龙般翻滚。
王林眼露羡慕之色，走进房间看了一圈，终于在一处门后看到了那十个庞大的水缸，苦笑一声，他拎起两个水桶向东门走去。
走了很远的路，这才来到对方说的泉眼，此地风景颇为秀丽，水声哗哗作响，犹如天籁之音弥人心菲。
王林无暇看这美景，把水桶装满，连忙拎起向山上走去。
一直到黄昏，他才倒满一缸，若不是中午他有甘薯填饱肚子，根本就没力气进行余下的工作。尽管如此，他现在双腿双臂已经酸麻，一用力就疼痛难忍。
他沉吟少许，拎着半桶水找到一处无人之地，谨慎的在四周观察一翻确定无人后，他从怀里拿出石珠，放在水桶里晃动一番，过了一会他捞出珠子收好，侩出桶里的水一喝，肚子里顿时出现一丝丝暖洋洋的感觉，全身肌肉的酸痛感慢慢消散。
虽然效果不如露水，但王林却极为兴奋，他摸了摸胸口放石珠的位置，再次决定决不能让人知道自己有这宝贝！
把半桶水都喝光后，他肌肉不再酸痛，精神气爽，立刻继续挑水的工作。
这一日，他装满了一缸半，又喝了半桶用神秘珠子浸泡的泉水后，为了怕别人怀疑，他装出一副疲惫不堪的神情回到住所，

不大一会，张虎回来了，脸上依然还是那副劳累过度的表情，二人交谈了几句，张虎犹豫半天，吞吞吐吐的讨要了两块甘薯，吃完后倒在床上呼呼大睡。
时间很快过去，转眼间王林在恒岳派已经一个月了。
王林现在知道，张虎的工作是砍柴，每日要砍够足量的木材方可吃饭，从他成为恒岳派记名弟子开始，就一直砍柴，已经三年了，三年前他往往三四天才能吃上一顿饭，全凭喝水填饱肚子，现如今他已经把时间缩短，两天就可吃顿饭。
据他说，记名弟子要干杂务十年，做到每日三餐顿顿都拉不下，只有同时满足了这两个要求，才可以被传授一些基础的仙法。
内门弟子与他们不同，有各自的师父，不用做任何杂务，有各人单独的房间，他们主要的工作就是修炼。
除此之外，还有一种人，介乎内门弟子与记名弟子之间，就是如王浩般成为别人的童子，其实所谓童子，直白来说就是仆人。

"Weasel?" Wang Lin was startled. The first thing he thought of was the young man in yellow who laughed at him before. He felt that he was more suitable for this title, but he didn't know if he was the one he was talking about.
"Ah? Didn't you see him? He is the man who is responsible for arranging the work of registered disciples. He is also a registered disciple, but he has obtained the qualification to practice immortal magic. He is wearing yellow clothes. He doesn't look like a good person at first glance. He looks like a wolf cub. We all call him that in private." Zhang Hu took a sip of water and explained through gritted teeth.
Wang Lin took a bite of the sweet potato and said, "I know who you are talking about. I saw him today and told me to carry ten tanks of water every day starting from tomorrow, otherwise there will be no food."
Zhang Hu was stunned and stared at Wang Lin for a long time, then suddenly asked: "Brother, did you have any grudge against him before?"
Wang Lin shook his head and asked, "What's wrong?"
Zhang Hu glanced at Wang Lin with a pitiful look and asked, "Wang Lin, do you think the big water tank is just like the one we use at home?" He gestured with his hands as he spoke.
Wang Lin had a bad feeling in his heart and nodded.
Zhang Hu smiled bitterly and said, "You must have offended the weasel. The big tank he was talking about is about the same size as our house, with ten full tanks of water... Wang Lin, I don't want these sweet potatoes anymore. You can keep them. I think you can eat one meal every four or five days, which is good." You are new here, and several places where wild fruits are grown in the mountains have been occupied by others. Only old people can pick a few. I'd better eat my wild fruits tomorrow." After saying that, he put the remaining pieces of sweet potatoes on the table, sighed, and lay down on the bed again to sleep.
A trace of evil fire arose in Wang Lin's heart. He gritted his teeth. Thinking of his parents' expectant eyes, he forcibly suppressed the fire and lay down on the bed, suffocating, and fell asleep.
The next day, before dawn, he climbed out of bed. Zhang Hu was still snoring. Wang Lin put on gray clothes and hurriedly walked to the utility room. The moment he arrived, the sun gradually appeared from the east. The young man in yellow opened the door, glanced at Wang Lin sideways, and said in a strange tone: "It's quite punctual. Go in and get a bucket. Go out along the east gate. There is a spring in the mountain. Go there to fetch water."
After saying that, he ignored Wang Lin and sat cross-legged on the ground, breathing slowly in front of the sunrise. A faint trace of white air came out from his nose, rolling like two white dragons.
Wang Lin's eyes showed envy. He walked into the room and looked around, and finally saw the ten huge water tanks behind a door. With a wry smile, he picked up two buckets and walked towards the east door.
After walking a long way, we came to the spring that the other party mentioned. The scenery here is quite beautiful, and the sound of the water is as sweet as the sound of nature.
Wang Lin had no time to look at the beautiful scenery, so he filled the bucket and quickly picked it up and walked up the mountain.
He didn't fill the tank until dusk. If he hadn't had sweet potatoes to fill his stomach at noon, he wouldn't have had the energy to do the rest of the work. Despite this, his legs and arms were now numb, and the pain was unbearable when he exerted himself.
He pondered for a while, carried half a bucket of water and found an uninhabited place. After carefully looking around to make sure that no one was there, he took out the stone beads from his arms and shook them in the bucket. After a while, he fished out the beads and put them away. When he took a drink of the water in the bucket, a warm feeling suddenly appeared in his stomach, and the soreness in the muscles all over his body slowly dissipated.
Although the effect was not as good as dew, Wang Lin was extremely excited. He touched the place where the stone bead was placed on his chest and decided again that no one should know that he had this treasure!
After drinking half of the bucket of water, his muscles no longer ached, he felt refreshed, and he immediately continued carrying water.
On this day, he filled a jar and a half and drank half a bucket of spring water soaked in mysterious beads.Afraid of being suspected, he pretended to be exhausted and returned to his residence.
After a while, Zhang Hu came back, with the same overworked expression on his face. The two chatted for a few words. Zhang Hu hesitated for a long time, hesitantly asked for two pieces of sweet potato, and after eating, he fell on the bed and fell asleep.
Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, Wang Lin had been in the Hengyue Sect for a month.
Wang Lin now knows that Zhang Hu’s job is to chop wood, and he must chop enough wood every day to eat. It has been three years since he became a registered disciple of the Hengyue Sect. Three years ago, it would often take him three or four days to have a meal, relying entirely on drinking water to fill his stomach. Now he has shortened the time and can have a meal in two days.
According to him, registered disciples have to do chores for ten years and have to eat three meals a day. Only if they meet these two requirements at the same time can they be taught some basic immortal skills.
The inner disciples are different from them. They have their own masters. They don't have to do any chores. They have separate rooms. Their main job is to practice.
In addition, there is another kind of person, between the inner disciples and the registered disciples, that is, like Wang Hao, a boy who becomes someone else. In fact, the so-called boy is, to put it bluntly, a servant.
